top_signals.title: RBI Turns Away All Bids at Treasury Bill Sale Amid Bond Selloff
top_signals.summary: India’s central bank rejected all bids at a sale of federal treasury bills on Wednesday amid a bond selloff that pushed borrowing costs to multi-year highs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: FTSE 100 landowner pulls £1.5bn London shopping centre plans in row with Green council
top_signals.summary: A FTSE 100-listed landowner has shelved plans for a £1.5bn shopping centre project in South London after a local Green-run council refused to co-operate with the plans. Property giant Landsec, which owns Lewisham Shopping Centre, said it is “deprioritising” its plans to redevelop the site following a row with the local authority over affordable housing.  [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Japan tourist spending rises despite drop in visitor arrivals
top_signals.summary: The news comes as Japan approaches the one-year mark since Chinese authorities began issuing advisories urging citizens to avoid travel to Japan.
